Amiri Decree No. (13) of 2023
Concerning Sending a Judge to Retirement
We, Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Ruler of Abu Dhabi,
Having reviewed:
• Law No. (1) of 1974 concerning the reorganisation of the Governmental
body in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi and its amendments;
• Law No. (23) of 2006 concerning the Judicial Department in the Emirate
of Abu Dhabi, and its amendments; and
• Based on what was proposed by the Judicial Council and as recommended
by the Chairman of the Judicial Department,
Issued the following Decree:
Article (1)
Judge/ Fahd Mohammed Salem Al-Harthy, Appeal Judge (Third Grade), shall
be sent to retirement.
Article (2)
This Decree shall be effective from the date of its issuance and published in
the Official Gazette.
Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
Ruler of Abu Dhabi
Issued by us in Abu Dhabi
On: 22 June 2023
Corresponding to 04 Dhi Al-Hijjah 1444 Hijri

Executive Council Resolution No. (66) of 2023
concerning the Appointment of the Director-General
of the Advanced Technology Research Council
The Executive Council has decided the following:
His Excellency Shahab Issa Abu Shahab Al Suwaidi, shall be appointed as
the Director-General of the Advanced Technology Research Council.
Saif Saeed Ghobash
Secretary-General
Issuance Date: 09 June 2023
Corresponding to: 20 Thu Al Qedah 1444 Hijri

Executive Council Resolution No. (67) of 2023
concerning the appointment of the Director-General
for Strategic Affairs at the Department of Government
Support
The Executive Council has decided the following:
Her Excellency Ruba Yousef Ahmed Al Hassan Al-Samreen shall be
appointed as the Director-General for Strategic Affairs at the Department of
Government Support.
Saif Saeed Ghobash
Secretary-General
Issuance Date: 09 June 2023
Corresponding to: 20 Thu Al Qedah 1444 Hijri

Executive Council Resolution No. (68) of 2023
concerning the Replacement of a Member of the
Board of Directors of Abu Dhabi General Services
Company
Having reviewed the Executive Council Resolution No. (59) of 2021
concerning the reformation of the Board of Directors of Abu Dhabi General
Services Company, the Executive Council has decided the following:
Mr. Al-Hassan Kaabous Al-Zaabi shall replace Mr. Ibrahim Khamis Mohammed
Al-Maghrabi in the membership of the Board of Directors of Abu Dhabi
General Services Company.
Saif Saeed Ghobash
Secretary-General
Issuance Date: 09 June 2023
Corresponding to: 20 Thu Al Qedah 1444 Hijri
